description: Route Lichtfestival Gent is a series of datasets listed in Open Data Portaal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Dienst Feesten en Ambulante Handel Gent. Deze dataset geeft de route van het Gentse lichtfestival in 2021 weer. Het lichtfestival gaat dit jaar door van 11 tot en met 14 november 2021. Coverage: Ghent. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Evenementen & Feesten. Its keywords are Evenement. The portal shows 1 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Modellicentie Gratis Hergebruik (https://www.vlaanderen.be/digitaal-vlaanderen/onze-oplossingen/open-data/voorwaarden-voor-het-hergebruik-van-overheidsinformatie/modellicentie-gratis-hergebruik). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-stad-gent-portal.
